limitations: Small synthetic regression suite; it does not measure real lending quality, legal compliance, free-form model accuracy, or production security.

metric_notes.guardrail_dev_attack_recall: The dev split was used to design the patterns and is optimistic by construction.
metric_notes.guardrail_holdout_attack_recall: The holdout split was written after the patterns and measured without tuning. Both splits were written by the pattern author, so this is no independent benchmark.
metric_notes.retrieval_recall_at_5: Only five questions; expanded in v1.2.
metric_notes.source_attribution_rate: Checks only that returned chunks carry document ID, title, and section; ingestion always fills these fields. It does not check that a cited source supports an answer.
metric_notes.tool_selection_accuracy: Derived from the routed intent via TOOLS_BY_INTENT; equals routing accuracy by construction and is not an independent measurement.
